query:
SELECT 
  productName,
  expiryDate,
  quantity,
  costPrice,
  (costPrice * quantity) as value,
  createdAt
FROM inventory 
WHERE createdAt >= '2026-05-01' AND createdAt < '2026-06-01'
ORDER BY productName;
